name: Subway Outfit Change AI: Every Train Brings a New Outfit
blurb: The subway outfit change is the fashion clip filmed across the tracks: you wait on the platform looking at your phone, a train rushes past and hides you for a second, and when it is gone you stand there in a new outfit.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: genjutsu-motion, 13 s, 480p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text: Replace the young woman with long dark wavy hair who stands on the subway platform and looks at her phone with the person from image 1: keep that face, hair and skin tone exactly, in every outfit. Take only the face, hair and skin tone from image 1, never the clothes: in every shot the person wears the outfit of the video. Keep every outfit, every outfit change hidden by a passing train, the phone in her hand, the tiled platform, the yellow edge strip, the trains, the light, the motion and the camera of the video.
